ROCKETSOCCER
BOOST SAVING · At supersonic (purple trail) let go of boost, it only burns tank · H / ⟲ = half-flip assist (turn around without stopping) · Wave dash: jump, tilt nose down, flip diagonally just before you land · drive over small pads and tap boost
Flips follow the nose of your car, not the field: a front-flip up a wall goes up the wall · aim the dodge through the centre of the ball for a hard hit (nose-up hits are weak) · for a flick keep the ball forward on the hood
WASD drive · Space jump, press again + direction = flip
